title: OrchJail: Jailbreaking Tool-Calling Text-to-Image Agents by Orchestration-Guided Fuzzing
reasoning: The paper presents a framework for jailbreaking tool-calling T2I agents. While the attacks target policy-violating content such as discrimination and violence, the focus is on the security/safety mechanism of jailbreaking and fuzzing rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of ethical, moral, or religious reasoning systems.
